An & that would read as a character reference in a link destination or title stays literal

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<a href=\"?&amp;plus;\" title=\"&amp;plus;\">T</a>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
